member.name: T:FZE.Entity
member.summary:
An object in the scene. Only its id: the object itself lives in the engine, so an Entity kept after the object was deleted points at nothing (IsValid says so) instead of at freed memory - the same rule the graph's object references follow.
What an entity can do is generated from the engine's own list of functions (Generated/EngineAPI.g.cs): GetPosition, SetPosition, Damage, Jump, PlayClip... - one method per node in the graph palette.
